measured_problem: The native rank-768 residual span is sufficient on held-out records (mean cosine 0.999126 and mean relative RMSE 0.036259), but the exact existing full-feature linear map plus three sparse route maps realizes only 0.989966 mean cosine and 0.101223 mean relative RMSE. Coefficient realization, not retained output rank, is the measured blocker.
proposed_method: Replace the existing bias-free 3072-by-768 linear coefficient projection with exactly one bias-free 3072-by-576-by-768 SiLU coefficient function. Keep the fixed v15 attention, native rank-768 mean and basis, sparse feature projection, three route residual maps, records, routes, and all quality gates unchanged.
material_differences: Introduces one nonlinear boundary into the measured coefficient function instead of repeating a linear solver, ridge, rank, route, data, or attention variant.
The nonlinear function has 2211840 values, 147456 fewer than the 2359296-value linear function it replaces.
Adds zero route-specific capacity and preserves the existing three sparse route maps.
Targets the same train-derived native coefficient coordinates and evaluates the exact proposed inference formula on the unchanged held-out split.
decision: Authorize exactly one separately preregistered no-artifact layer-zero capacity screen. Any held-out miss closes this nonlinear mapper without hidden-width, optimizer, step, learning-rate, seed, loss, normalization, data, route, rank, attention, layer, or source sweeps.
claim_boundary: Architecture-review authorization only; no fit, extracted model, autonomous quality, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority evidence.
